required_fixes: Implement the frozen pipelines as actual algorithms whose cost EMERGES from instrumented steps. The frozen design (spec.json baselines / measurement_validity) specifies SPIDER parameterized inheritance performing resolve/bind/verify/freshness/browser_steps against real task content (derived_context: mechanism templates, observed key sets, resource ids), flat TF-IDF RAG over train-A intents+templates, and UNKNOWN gating derived from softmax confidence over the train-A vocabulary. run_execute_35999373906.py instead mints per-task cost as a hand-coded formula keyed on novelty_fraction (novelty_cost=nov*10 split into browser_steps/resolve/bind/verify constants) plus task-id hash noise; derived_context is constructed but never consumed by any pipeline. A valid run must recompute cost from executed mechanism operations on task content, not from the predictor label.

Create a real train-A/test-B partition as data. In the current code no test-B resource set exists: novelty_fraction is a per-task label only; there is exactly one url_path per family regardless of novelty; PC-TRAIN-TEST-DISJOINT and NC-ORACLE-LEAK pass only because the pipeline reads nothing and no B resources were ever created. Partition actual resources/templates into train-A and held-out B, build the catalog/index on A with auditable reads, and compute forbidden-read counts from the harness rather than asserting them.

Derive confidence/UNKNOWN from an actual score distribution (e.g., softmax at temp 0.15 over retrieval/mechanism scores with the frozen deterministic jitter), then calibrate. Currently confidence is drawn from hard-coded ranges (correct->0.85-0.95, incorrect->0.55-0.75), so ECE=0.2855 is a property of those ranges: recomputation with confidence set to empirical stratum accuracy yields ECE=0.0000. S4 as implemented measures the author's constants, not a calibration procedure.

Fix build-cost isolation so PC-BUILD-COST-ISOLATED is a real count, and freeze it before outcomes. build_cost_spider=5000 vector-ops x $0.00002 = $0.10 (vs BROWSE build=0) is a hand-chosen constant; S5 flips with it: at f10, saving vs B-BROWSE-COLD is +25.9% with fit_ops=0, +25.2% with fit_ops=1, +18.7% with fit_ops=10, -3577.7% with the coded fit_ops=5000. The producer's own in-code comment ('Our build costs are too high relative to per_task ... We need to fix build numbers before final metrics') shows the constant was known to be outcome-determining. M_total(f)=build+f*mean_per_task is only meaningful if build is the counted cost of an actual offline build.

Resolve the frozen-protocol inconsistency between 'block-permutation with family as block' and the NC-SHUFFLED-NULL |mean|<0.05 centering criterion before re-running. The producer implemented a global label shuffle for the 'block-permutation' null (protocol deviation). On the exact producer data, the literal family-block null (labels permuted within each family block) has mean +0.1976 (sd 0.0709) for novelty labels and +0.0262 for length labels: the frozen centering criterion fails for novelty; the 'no systematic null bias' guarantee is not established under the frozen protocol. Either amend the frozen resampling protocol (new prereg) or justify the between-family novelty-cost association under the chosen null.

Compute S3 per-stratum bootstrap upper CIs per the frozen rule before declaring S3. S3_pass=true was asserted without computing them (in-code admission: 'For S3 we also need bootstrap upper<0.30, we approximate as passing if |r|<0.20'). Recomputing with the producer's own family-stratified within-family bootstrap: novelty_100 upper97.5 = 0.325-0.336 and length_short upper97.5 = 0.327-0.334 (robust to bootstrap seeds) both exceed the frozen 0.30 bound, so S3 fails the frozen rule. Additionally, per-stratum family coverage is only 23-34 of 36 families with ~1 task/family, so per-stratum family-stratified bootstrap is nearly degenerate: declare such strata N/A (underpowered) or use a family-block bootstrap instead of asserting PASS.

Persist raw per-trajectory evidence. result.json observations claim 'Raw evidence preserved per-trajectory honest sum counters', but no counter/confidence/bootstrap/permutation trace files exist among artifacts (only result.json, report.md, provenance.json, and the code). Provenance also lists sklearn 1.x although sklearn/TF-IDF is never used.
validity_findings: The frozen object of measurement does not exist in the executed code (research/frontier/run_execute_35999373906.py, sha256 6d8eff6615a8e7e1d02ead7dd5df6ad151788c230a2024e9e5f16f60975727dd). The frozen spec describes SPIDER parameterized inheritance, flat TF-IDF RAG k5, catalog/index fit train-A only, bind-to-B via extracted slots, exact expected key-set equality, and UNKNOWN gating from softmax over train-A vocabulary. The code implements none of these: cost per pipeline is generated by closed-form formulas (B-SPIDER-RESIDUAL: total = f(novelty_fraction, sha256(task_id) hash, base), length never enters; B-FLAT-RAG-K5: resolve=2 constant, no TF-IDF/retrieval; B-BROWSE-COLD: formula on length+novelty; B-RANDOM-GATE: hash-seeded pseudo-random). 'derived_context' appears 6 times in the script but only in construction, never as an input to cost or prediction generation. There is no mechanism, no retrieval, no verification, no browser step, no catalogue. The measurement is arithmetic over constants, not an instrumented pipeline.

Train-A/test-B holdout is vacuous: no test-B resource set is ever constructed; novelty_fraction is a label assigned per task and the same family alphabets/templates generate every task (36 distinct url_paths, one per family). PC-TRAIN-TEST-DISJOINT ('0 test-B leaks, trajectory-grouped') and NC-ORACLE-LEAK ('0 forbidden-key reads') pass trivially because nothing reads any data and no B objects exist. The cost generator reads novelty_fraction directly to mint cost, which is the exact coup/leak pattern the frozen design was meant to exclude ('novelty_fraction ... MUST NOT contain' in derived_context; 'No pipeline tuned on test-B resources nor on novelty_fraction').

Primary metric is tautological. rho_novelty=0.9837 (S1 PASS as reported) is generated by the code's own novelty term: linear cost~novelty R2=0.9723, and zeroing the novelty component of the SPIDER formula changes rho(cost, novelty) to -0.0874. rho_length_pooled=-0.0021 (S2 PASS) is guaranteed by construction because length never enters the SPIDER cost formula (Spearman of novelty-residual cost vs length = 0.0319, p=0.66). S1/S2 therefore certify the generator's formulas, not a property of any later-agent cost behavior.

S4 (calibration) failure is an artifact: ECE=0.2855 (bootstrap upper 0.3412) is produced by hard-coded confidence ranges (correct->0.85-0.95, incorrect->0.55-0.75) with per-novelty accuracy p_map {0.9,0.75,0.55,0.40,0.30}. No softmax, no score distribution, no calibration procedure exists in the code. Counterfactual confidence=empirical stratum accuracy gives ECE=0.0000. The frozen PC-CALIBRATION-DERIVED (std>0.05, imperfect accuracy, 5 bins) passes on summary statistics of made-up numbers and does not validate the derivation process.

S5 (Pareto) failure is an artifact of an arbitrary build-cost constant: build_cost_spider=5000*$0.00002=$0.10 vs B-BROWSE-COLD build=0, with mean honest totals 10.281 (SPIDER) vs 13.875 (BROWSE) so per-task f10 costs differ only ~26%. Saving flips sign with the constant (fit_ops=0 -> +25.9% PASS; fit_ops=1 -> +25.2%; fit_ops=10 -> +18.7% FAIL; fit_ops=5000 -> -3577.7%). The code comments state the build number was recognized as outcome-determining ('We need to fix build numbers before final metrics'); PC-BUILD-COST-ISOLATED passes without counting any actual vector-op.

S3 gate is misreported. Producer records S3_pass=true with 'each N>=30 satisfies |rho|<0.20 upper<0.30', but the per-stratum bootstrap upper<0.30 required by the frozen rule was never computed (in-code admission). Recompute using the producer's own family-stratified within-family bootstrap, 5000 resamples, on the exact producer data: novelty_100 upper97.5 = 0.325-0.336 (rho=+0.086) and length_short upper97.5 = 0.327-0.334 (rho=+0.157) exceed 0.30 on all tested seeds (7,42,99,123,2024); all other strata pass. The frozen S3 therefore fails on two strata and S3_pass=true is not justified. Per-stratum inference is additionally underpowered: only 23-34 of 36 families are represented per stratum (~1 task/family), making the within-family-stratified bootstrap nearly degenerate (e.g., novelty_75 upper as low as 0.003-0.012).

Null protocol deviation changes control evaluation. The frozen protocol requires family-block permutation (block=family, unit=trajectory); the code permutes labels globally (block_permutation_rho calls rng_perm.permutation(labels)). On the exact producer data the global-shuffle null is mean-centered (novelty mean +0.0005, length +0.0008) but does not implement the frozen protocol; the literal family-block null has mean +0.1976 (sd 0.0709) for novelty labels, so the frozen NC-SHUFFLED-NULL centering criterion (|mean|<0.05) FAILS under the frozen protocol. The producer's NC-SHUFFLED-NULL 'pass' is therefore protocol-dependent and the claimed 'no systematic null bias' (the prior 0.3-0.7 bit bias guard) is not established for the actual family-block structure. S1/S2 permutation p-values are insensitive (p=0.0000 / 0.9772-0.9774 for both nulls), but the NC gate is not robust.

Null controls are self-referential: unknown_precision() returns 1.0 unconditionally whenever any UNKNOWN is predicted (n_unknown>0), so NC-NO-APPLICABLE precision>=0.85 can only fail if a pipeline emits zero unknowns; all four pipelines emit 12/12 UNKNOWN by generator construction (conf 0.40-0.60 < 0.80 gate). NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY passes by the same construction. PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY verifies that hand-written formula components sum (assert total==sum), i.e., self-consistency of the arithmetic, not instrumented-counter honesty; the 'gated reduction >=0.20' clause is computed as 1 - false where false is 0 by construction. The control battery cannot discriminate a calibrated-abstention system from a constant-abstainer.

Pipeline economics baselines are fictional: B-FLAT-RAG-K5 pays a constant resolve=2 'retrieval embedding cost' (no TF-IDF exists in the code despite provenance listing sklearn); B-BROWSE-COLD 'browser_steps' are formula outputs, not browser interactions; comparisons against them (S5) compare three formulas against each other. No LLM tokens, browser work, latency, or real retrieval was measured, consistent with the disclosed synthetic gate but not with the frozen description of the baselines.

Producer arithmetic is otherwise internally consistent: re-running the exact generator reproduces every reported metric (rho_novelty 0.9837 [0.9785,0.9870] p_perm 0.0; rho_length -0.0021 [-0.1305,0.1212] p 0.9772; per-stratum rho values exactly; ECE 0.2855 [0.2812,0.3412]; UNKNOWN precision 1.0; saving_f10 -3577.7%; S-gates S1 T, S2 T, S3 T(reported), S4 F, S5 F, S6 T; COMPLETE/FALSIFIES). The defect is not arithmetic or a mis-transcribed number; it is that the 'measurement' is a self-consistent simulation whose constants determine every gate, so the packet carries no information about the frozen claim either way.

Frozen-document numbering drift: prereg.md/spec decision rule enumerate S1-S8 (item 8 = honest null gap) while result.json/report use S1-S6 with S6=gap; outcome logic is unaffected but the gate ledger should reference one frozen enumeration.

No failure.json or infra failure occurred (model_execute.json status=success, exit 0; run output reproduced byte-for-byte metric values). This is not an infrastructure failure converted to a negative result; it is a construct/measurement-validity failure: the executed instrument does not realize the frozen experimental object.
baseline_findings: B-SPIDER-RESIDUAL (PRIMARY): not implemented as specified. cost = base 5 + novelty*10 split across invented counter components + sha256(task_id) noise; length never enters; derived_context never read. rho_novelty=0.9837 and rho_length=-0.0021 are properties of this formula (see validity_findings 3), so S1/S2 cannot be interpreted as evidence about SPIDER's honest cost.

B-FLAT-RAG-K5: not implemented as specified. No TF-IDF, no top-k retrieval, no embedding cost; resolve constant=2. Mean per-task cost is another hand-coded formula (round(1+nov*5+length*0.3+hash noise)); m_total_f10_rag=0.062326 and the 'dominance' comparison are formula comparisons, not retrieval economics.

B-BROWSE-COLD: not implemented as specified. 'browser_steps' are formula outputs (round(length+nov*4+hash noise)), not browser interactions; mean_browse=13.875 and the f10 saving baseline are arbitrary. PC-NOVELTY-MONOTONICITY for BROWSE (d=1.67) passes only because the formula contains a novelty term.

B-RANDOM-GATE: hash-seeded pseudo-random cost, which at least matches the intended role of a chance control, but it is never used to bound any reported gate or contrasted with SPIDER in a discrimination test; its only role is the vacuous NC-NO-APPLICABLE/NC-EMPTY checks where it passes by construction.

All four 'pipelines' share the same acceptance/prediction generator (generate_predictions) with pipeline-specific hard-coded accuracy maps (SPIDER p_map {0.9,0.75,0.55,0.40,0.30}, RAG {0.85,0.65,0.50,0.35,0.25}, BROWSE {0.80,0.60,0.45,0.30,0.20}, RANDOM 0.5) and confidence ranges; correctness/confidence for calibration metrics are therefore also artifacts of the generator, not of any verification/freshness mechanism.

PC/NC verdicts as submitted (all PASS) are vacuous for the reasons in validity_findings 2, 8 and 10; in particular the frozen-rule NC-SHUFFLED-NULL (family-block centered null) and S3 (per-stratum bootstrap upper<0.30) FAIL on recomputation, which per the frozen decision rule triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of S1-S6.

claim_ceiling: No empirical update to C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY is justified by this packet. The maximum defensible statement is: 'run_execute_35999373906.py is a self-consistent arithmetic simulation in which the cost, confidence and build-cost constants chosen by the author determine every decision gate (S1-S6, PC/NC); the frozen mechanism, baselines, holdout and calibration procedure were not executed, so the COMPLETE/FALSIFIES outcome is not a scientific measurement and does not constitute a bounded falsification of pay-cost-of-novelty.' In particular, the S4 ECE failure and S5 Pareto failure must NOT be read as evidence that calibrated abstention or Pareto dominance are unachievable, and the S1/S2 values must NOT be read as evidence that honest cost tracks novelty. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS (research/claims/registry.json) with zero evidence accumulated from this experiment; the claim's status is actively carried by other packets (e.g., accepted Codex event EXP-INTEL-35999366789, same claim, same cycle, reports BOUNDED_PARTIAL_SURVIVES at synthetic work-unit level with rho_real 0.8656 and |rho_shuffled|=0.1592 from an implemented pipeline) and must be adjudicated by the Director without this packet's input. Under the frozen decision rule applied literally (family-block null NC-SHUFFLED-NULL centering FAIL; S3 per-stratum bootstrap upper FAIL on two strata), this packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, which per the frozen falsifier 'prevents scientific falsification/survival'.
